items.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: And we became very good friends. And I considered it a great pleasure and an honor to be able to record him.

ctx.x: And we became very good friends. And I considered it a great pleasure and an honor to be able to record him.
He had a certain legato tonguing style on his instrument I really, really like. And I just am always amazed at his inventiveness with creating melodies, which is what I like to hear in an improviser.
